When you go outside to prove yourself, you come across different enemies. If you defeat them, you gain a trophy. In the ending screen, you can click on the trophies to learn stories about why certain cats (queens only) are in the dark forest.





Nightsong - Rat horde
She was the mate of a tyrannical leader. She wasn't super evil, but she stood by him. She even chose to go to the Dark Forest with him after they were both killed by poison hidden in their fresh-kill.

Sweetcloud - Coyote
Her sister had half clan kits, which were against the warrior code. Sweetcloud wanted to 'save' her sister (Current leader enjoyed using cruel punishment), so she killed her sister's kits (by leaving them outside a coyote den). Her sister then killed her.


Marshclaw - Snake
Marshclaw has always resented Starclan since they made a bad cat, Nightsong's mate, leader. Her resentment grew when she traveled to the moonpool (while pregnant) only to find a snake instead. She started rejecting her warrior name for some reason?
